i came into this settings menu to change ONE thing. dark mode. that's it. that was in march. it is now whatever the Legal Fog says it is, and last time i asked, the Fog said 'month' was a premium concept not included in my tier.

every time i hit BACK it loads a newer agreement. every time i hit AGREE it spawns a sub-agreement nested inside the agreement i just agreed to. there is no HOME button. i checked the terms. the HOME button is described, verbatim, as 'aspirational.'

page 4 says i own my body. page 5 defines 'my body' as licensed hardware. page 6 clarifies that page 4 was a promotional example and is no longer being honored in your region. i have now read this exact sequence three thousand times and somehow it gets WORSE the more familiar it gets.

KNIFEBOY DM'd me 'just leave lol.' LEAVE. my guy. there is no door in a menu. the door is a checkbox, and the checkbox says 'i have read and understood,' and i have NOT understood — that IS the emergency, that is the entire situation, you cannot exit a room by lying about the room.
